snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Z Broly Moveset Showcase by Super Hype Bros
snippet.description:
It is finally here! We are so happy to release our Z Broly moveset for SSBU!!
Download it here: https://gamebanana.com/mods/630616

If interested in following our work closer and helping us make those movesets, please join the Super Hype Bros Discord Server: https://discord.gg/Fv4HMgxvUU

Here are some of the main features:
- 20 different alts and costumes showing various representations of Broly through years (We will be releasing a tool to remove/add alts and costumes you want/don't want)
- Expressions
- Swing Physics for the hair and cloth (Different physics for the different hairs)
- Custom Command Grabs
- A very thorough balancing to make him balanced amongst the other characters

Credits to these artists for the music used in the showcase video:
- Eminence Front - The Who (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BfrUQA2tb6M&list=RDBfrUQA2tb6M&start_radio=1)
- Yu Yu Hakusho Soundtrack (Time limit) - FreackingLombax (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Foc3ME3fJ0&list=RD2Foc3ME3fJ0&start_radio=1)

A huge thanks to everyone who supported us and helped us along the way!!
